Shopee: coming soon

The TikTok Shop branch runs fully. The Shopee branch already has its intake layer and only needs a sample export file to map column names.

Why switching platform does not need a rewrite

All diagnostic logic sits in the metric layer and is not tied to any platform's column names. The four diagnostic groups, median benchmark, icon signal layer, 2-way cross table and manual target ROI are all shared.

The only difference between the two platforms is the column-name mapping layer: each platform calls the same thing by a different name. Once mapped, every tab, chart and Excel file works the same.

Enabling Shopee = filling 2 things in the ENGINE block: the file detection signature, and the column → standard schema mapping. The calculation, chart and export layers are not touched.

What is needed to enable it

  1. Shopee video export file: the version with GMV per video/content in the period.
  2. Booking file: still the current system file, filtered to Nền tảng = Shopee. The Link air/Link nghiệm thu column already holds Shopee links, so nothing changes on the system side.
  3. Rule for extracting the video ID from a Shopee link (TikTok uses a 15–25 digit sequence in the URL; Shopee uses another structure).
The current sample booking file has 38 rows with platform Shopee: enough to test the mapping as soon as the platform export is available.

Minimum fields needed in the Shopee export

If a field is missing, the matching column stays empty and the rest still runs, the same way the tool handles a missing booking file.

Video Affiliate performance diagnostic

TikTok Shop · running Shopee · coming soon : the diagnostic logic is shared by both platforms; Shopee only needs a sample export file to map column names. Click the Shopee button at the top to see what is needed.

Joins the platform video file with the system booking file, separates KOC Open (organic videos) and KOC Targeted (videos we paid to book), then answers: where money flows, which layer is blocked, and which group budget should move to.

Prepare 2 files

  1. Platform file: Video Performance List (.xlsx). Detected by the ID video column. This is the list of videos contributing GMV in the period, not newly aired videos.
  2. System file: booking approval list (.xlsx). Detected by the Mã Booking column. The tool reads the video ID from the Link air/Link nghiệm thu column.
The platform file alone is enough to run. Without the booking file every video goes to KOC Open, and dimensions 3 and 4 stay empty.

5 steps

  1. Drag the 2 files into the Import data screen, into either box; the tool detects them.
  2. Read the check table: how many videos were mapped, how many bookings have no link.
  3. Adjust the GMV filter threshold (default > 1,000,000 ₫) and the target ROI.
  4. Review the 7 result tabs across the 5 dimensions.
  5. Download Excel to share with the team or print to PDF.

Four diagnostic groups

Split on 2 axes, with the threshold at the median of the video set being analysed (recalculated every period, not hardcoded): traffic axis = Views, conversion axis = CTOR (orders / product clicks).

STAR – scale
Many views, good closing. Replicate the formula, increase budget.
CONVERSION GAP
Enough views but no orders. Fix the sales content / product page. Do not add more traffic.
TRAFFIC GAP
Good closing but few viewers. This is the group most worth boosting with ads.
FULL FUNNEL GAP
Both layers broken. Stop replicating, review the brief and KOC selection.

What the tool recalculates, what it keeps

Kept (pass-through): every metric already in the platform file. Verified in code on a real file: Tỷ lệ nhấp (Video) = Product clicks / VV · CTOR = Recorded SKU orders / Product clicks · GPM = GMV from video / VV × 1000.

Added: every group-level metric is a ratio of totals (weighted), not an average of individual videos. With a plain average, a 200-view video would weigh as much as a 500,000-view video.

Empty cells stay empty, never forced to 0, and are excluded from the median.

Order of priority

  1. P1: CONVERSION GAP first. Enough views with no orders means every extra unit of traffic leaks. Conversion problems are not solved by buying more traffic.
  2. P2: TRAFFIC GAP. Conversion is proven, only views are missing: this is where ads are cheapest.
  3. P0: STAR. Replicate: same channel, same content angle, same product.
  4. P3: FULL FUNNEL GAP. Stop replicating, go back to the brief. Do not patch small things.
